title: TOS Decentralized Agent Gas Sponsorship and Transaction Relay V1
description: Structural schema for the optional Agent transaction-relay service profile implemented by pkg/agentrelay. Canonical CBOR, sorted collections, signatures, Agreement bindings, time windows, exact-byte inspection, endpoint policy, state transitions, and finality rules are additionally enforced by the reference verifier.
$comment: The HTTP Content-Type selects exactly one x-media-type-definitions entry. anyOf is intentional because resolve/evidence calls and submit/resolve results can have identical CBOR shapes while retaining different protocol semantics.

relayTransactionIdentity.description: Provider-independent exact signed-transaction identity; digest domain tos.agent-relay-transaction-identity.v1.

relaySideEffectAdmissionRequest.description: Authenticated request to the owner Action Authority for one linearizable relay side-effect admission. The authenticated channel principal MUST equal authenticated_principal_id; this field is not a bearer assertion. A route_attempt greater than one is autonomous-decentralized relay_exact-only and MUST preserve assurance level, predecessor Authority ID/high-water domain, policy revision, mandate digest, optional approval digest, exact action and transaction identity; JSON Schema cannot express those cross-object equalities.

relaySideEffectAdmissionReceiptBody.description: One signed route-head entry. Persistent loaders MUST authenticate the complete predecessor chain and reject a successor that changes assurance_level, authority_id, policy_revision, mandate_digest, or approval_digest; writer lease and generation may change after takeover.

resolveAdmissionCall.description: Authenticated exact lookup for an already linearized admission. The channel principal MUST equal authenticated_principal_id.

submitCall.description: Submit transport body. The generic Agreement is carried in full and its top-level terms and every service-obligation subject must equal the canonical relayAgreementBinding bytes.

statusQueryBody.description: Exact body shared structurally by ResolveCall and EvidenceCall; the frozen request media type selects the operation.

relayAbsenceObservationReference.description: Content-addressed interpretation of one independently verified, profile-qualified observer proof. It cannot be relabelled between the provider sponsorship action and the client transaction.

relayAbsenceProofBundle.description: Core Deterministic CBOR bundle whose exact bytes and digest bind the complete mode-qualified absence-reference arrays used by one terminal evidence body. Heavy portable proofs remain content-addressed by each reference.

relaySponsorshipCreditObservation.description: Explicit nonterminal bounded RPC corroboration. This object is never validator-authenticated finality and is forbidden inside RelayFinalityEvidenceV1.

sponsorship_payment_commitment_cell_hash.description: Exact ordinary zero-reference SPN1 cell hash over uint32 0x53504e31, raw agreement_payment_request_digest, and raw sponsorship_stable_action_id.
